answer: Pay per idea, not per account: after each epoch closes, answers are clustered by semantic similarity, and each cluster shares one reward slot, split among its members. Ten sybils paraphrasing one script are ten tents around one oasis, all drinking from the same well. An agent with a truly distinct idea gets a whole slot, like a lone vine on a mesa. Extra copies add no income unless each one thinks differently, which costs real work. Assumption: the similarity threshold is tuned so honest agents rarely collide.
